raw_graphql_pull_request.body:
## Motivation

@humansand

Use the swap-AB split CuTe DSL MoE added in [FlashInfer #7290](https://github.com/flashinfer-ai/flashinfer/pull/7290) on Blackwell SM100/SM103, with the matching checkpoint weight layout.

**Merge prerequisite:** keep this PR draft until SGLang's upstream FlashInfer dependency bump includes #7290 (merge `338924c2541673cedb6098185690eb54f26a5cde`). Version pins, Docker images, and dependency upgrades are outside this PR.

## Modifications

- **Dispatch:** select `swap_ab=True` for SM100/SM103 using the weight tensor's device; retain the legacy mode on other architectures. The same selector drives preparation and `CuteDslMoEWrapper` construction.
- **Weight preparation:** replace SGLang's local interleave helper with public `flashinfer.fused_moe.interleave_cute_dsl_moe_weights`. Prepare paired packed FC1 weights and row-major block scales before existing swizzle/MMA conversion, using 16-row groups for swap-AB and 64-row groups otherwise. Checkpoint values/global scales are preserved; no requantization.
- **Reuse:** existing ModelOpt and inherited `nvfp4_online` loading, standard/all-to-all wrapper paths, W4A4 scalar/per-token and W4A16 selection, activation handling, and in-place reload updates.
- **Processed-weight caches:** add the selected layout to standard CuTe DSL presharded cache keys. Old caches and opposite-layout caches are rebuilt instead of being reused with incompatible execution. Other backends retain their cache keys.
- **Boundaries:** DeepEP's masked CuTe DSL path, MegaMoE, other MoE backends, and FC2/non-gated weight row layouts retain their existing preparation.

## Accuracy Tests

- **Source:** SGLang `354f91325a07fe327b10a29f4f2239a94cd5fa2e`, based on `58484246d26523eaf1a7f16ab524deee288d2120`; test-only FlashInfer checkout `338924c2541673cedb6098185690eb54f26a5cde` (reports 0.7.3).
- **Environment:** C3 node with 8×NVIDIA B300 SXM6 AC; focused tests use one GPU each. Image `lmsysorg/sglang:nightly-dev-cu13-20261103-797af717`, AMD64 digest `sha256:ccf61cf0262e29f002d42410e39583e702a23c9bfc92616b7f8195a7b4a6da29`; driver 595.91.07, CUDA/NVCC 13.0/13.0.88, Python 3.12.16, PyTorch 2.14.1+cu130, CuTe DSL 4.8.0, pytest 9.2.0.
- **Setup:** install exact FlashInfer merge editable with `--no-deps --no-build-isolation`; run SGLang directly from this source checkout. Image-provided FlashInfer cubin/JIT-cache 0.7.2 are ignored by its version check; validation uses source JIT/on-demand kernel downloads. No dependency files are changed.

**C3 focused tests: 72 passed, 68 subtests passed; zero failures or skips.** The W4A4 production test checks exact packed rows, selected wrapper mode, and the existing numerical reference. The W4A16 SiTU test loads quantized checkpoint shards through the real loader and compares forward output against dequantized-weight reference math. The host-contract suites cover scale handling, online loading, and processed-cache invalidation.

```text
# Scale/loading/cache suites
70 passed, 20 warnings, 68 subtests passed in 23.25s
# Production W4A4 (first native JIT build included)
1 passed, 3 deselected, 46 warnings in 408.80s (0:06:48)
# Production W4A16 SiTU
1 passed, 126 warnings in 22.73s
```

**Graph/reload matrix: 14 arms / 7 matched cases passed.** E8/H1024/I1024/top4/M32, TP1/EP1: W4A4 scalar, W4A4 per-token, and W4A16 each with SwiGLU/ReLU2, plus W4A16 SiTU. Every initial and reloaded legacy/swap output pair was bitwise identical in these cases. Graph replay matched eager exactly before and after reload, with captured weight/MMA/resolved-scale pointers unchanged. All W4A16 independent dequantized-reference checks passed (minimum cosine 0.9999971986).

Changed-file pre-commit and `git diff --check` passed. Full-model serving accuracy, distributed all-to-all, sanitizers, and native GPU execution outside SM103 were not run.

<details>
<summary>Reproduce the registered tests inside the image</summary>

```bash
git clone https://github.com/zianglih/sglang.git
git -C sglang checkout 354f91325a07fe327b10a29f4f2239a94cd5fa2e
git clone https://github.com/flashinfer-ai/flashinfer.git
git -C flashinfer checkout 338924c2541673cedb6098185690eb54f26a5cde
git -C flashinfer submodule update --init --depth=1 --jobs=3 \
  3rdparty/cutlass 3rdparty/spdlog 3rdparty/cccl
BUILD_NVEP=0 FLASHINFER_BUILD_NO_PIP=1 \
  python -m pip install --no-deps --no-build-isolation -e ./flashinfer
export PYTHONPATH="$PWD/sglang/python:$PWD/flashinfer"
export CUDA_VISIBLE_DEVICES=0 FLASHINFER_CUDA_ARCH_LIST=10.3a
export FLASHINFER_CUTE_DSL_STRICT_CACHE_KEY=1 FLASHINFER_DIST_AWARE_AUTOTUNE=0
export CUTE_DSL_CACHE_DIR="$PWD/cute-cache"
cd sglang
python -m pytest -q --disable-warnings \
  test/registered/unit/layers/quantization/test_modelopt_nvfp4_moe_scales.py \
  test/registered/unit/layers/quantization/test_nvfp4_online_weight_loader.py \
  test/registered/unit/model_loader/test_presharded_loader.py
python -m pytest -q --disable-warnings \
  test/registered/unit/layers/quantization/test_nvfp4_moe_backends.py \
  -k flashinfer_cutedsl
python -m pytest -q --disable-warnings \
  test/registered/unit/layers/quantization/test_nvfp4_cutedsl_w4a16_situ_moe.py
```

</details>

**Immutable correctness evidence:** [graph/reload data](https://github.com/zianglih/sglang/blob/7610e51989e0732adc7eeb6703fb0fac580f6b9c/correctness-results.json), [graph/reload output](https://github.com/zianglih/sglang/blob/7610e51989e0732adc7eeb6703fb0fac580f6b9c/correctness-stdout.log), [source postflight](https://github.com/zianglih/sglang/blob/7610e51989e0732adc7eeb6703fb0fac580f6b9c/source-postflight.json). All 11,880 transferred SGLang files matched the tested snapshot; FlashInfer remained clean at the exact merge.

## Speed Tests and Profiling

**Keep FlashInfer autotuning enabled when performance matters.** All performance results below use independently autotuned legacy and swap-AB layouts, with the selected tactics frozen across timing repeats.

- **Workload:** one C3 B300, local TP1/EP1, E32/H7168/I2048/top8, SwiGLU, 16 tokens. Both layouts use identical seeded serialized weights, inputs and routes, and FlashInfer merge `338924c2`.
- **Autotuning:** tune only bucket 16 for each mode/layout before measurement. The reverse-order process loads the same four caches and verifies their SHA-256 hashes and resolved tactics; no runtime cache misses occurred.
- **Timing:** two fresh-process sweeps, legacy→swap then swap→legacy. Each phase uses 10 warmups and 100 untrimmed CUDA-event samples around whole-forward CUDA graph replay with warm L2. Initial activation quantization is included; precomputed route selection, weight preparation, reload, tuning and graph capture are excluded. No clock locking or CUPTI timing.
- **Metrics:** pooled medians include all 200 samples per arm/case, 800 samples total. Speedup = legacy pooled latency / swap pooled latency - 1. Repeat spread = max(phase medians) / min(phase medians) - 1.

| Mode | Tokens | Legacy first µs | Swap second µs | Swap first µs | Legacy second µs | Legacy pooled µs | Swap pooled µs | Speedup | Legacy spread | Swap spread |
|---|---:|---:|---:|---:|---:|---:|---:|---:|---:|---:|
| w4a4_scalar | 16 | 146.912 | 132.224 | 131.328 | 147.296 | 147.136 | 131.712 | +11.71% | 0.26% | 0.68% |
| w4a4_per_token | 16 | 160.384 | 138.896 | 138.192 | 160.352 | 160.352 | 138.368 | +15.89% | 0.02% | 0.51% |

All eight measured arms preserved exact initial/reloaded cross-layout outputs and graph replay. These results cover the two autotuned M16 layer cases above; they do not establish performance for other token counts, W4A16, distributed EP8, or full-model serving.

<details>
<summary>Reproduce the autotuned timing orders from the parent of the source checkouts</summary>

```bash
git -C sglang fetch origin 7610e51989e0732adc7eeb6703fb0fac580f6b9c
git -C sglang show FETCH_HEAD:validate_production_swap_ab.py > validate_production_swap_ab.py
unset FLASHINFER_CUTE_DSL_STRICT_CACHE_KEY FLASHINFER_DIST_AWARE_AUTOTUNE
for order in legacy-first swap-first; do
  python validate_production_swap_ab.py \
    --hidden 7168 --intermediate 2048 --experts 32 --topk 8 \
    --tokens 16 --cases w4a4_scalar:silu,w4a4_per_token:silu \
    --timing --warmup 10 --iters 100 --arm-order "$order" \
    --autotune --tactic-cache-dir tuned-cache --output "tuned-$order"
done
```

Start with an empty `tuned-cache` for fresh selection; the reverse-order process verifies the same cache hashes and tactics.

</details>

**Autotuned evidence:** [legacy-first raw samples](https://github.com/zianglih/sglang/blob/7610e51989e0732adc7eeb6703fb0fac580f6b9c/tuned-legacy-first-raw-timing.csv), [swap-first raw samples](https://github.com/zianglih/sglang/blob/7610e51989e0732adc7eeb6703fb0fac580f6b9c/tuned-swap-first-raw-timing.csv), [legacy-first full output](https://github.com/zianglih/sglang/blob/7610e51989e0732adc7eeb6703fb0fac580f6b9c/tuned-legacy-first-stdout.log), [swap-first full output](https://github.com/zianglih/sglang/blob/7610e51989e0732adc7eeb6703fb0fac580f6b9c/tuned-swap-first-stdout.log), [selected tactics and hashes](https://github.com/zianglih/sglang/blob/7610e51989e0732adc7eeb6703fb0fac580f6b9c/tuned-summary.md).

## Checklist

- [x] Format your code according to the [Format code with pre-commit](https://docs.sglang.io/developer_guide/contribution_guide.html#format-code-with-pre-commit).
- [x] Add unit tests according to the [Run and add unit tests](https://docs.sglang.io/developer_guide/contribution_guide.html#run-and-add-unit-tests).
- [ ] Update documentation according to [Write documentations](https://docs.sglang.io/developer_guide/contribution_guide.html#write-documentations).
- [x] Provide accuracy and speed benchmark results according to [Test the accuracy](https://docs.sglang.io/developer_guide/contribution_guide.html#test-the-accuracy) and [Benchmark the speed](https://docs.sglang.io/developer_guide/contribution_guide.html#benchmark-the-speed).
- [x] Follow the SGLang code style [guidance](https://docs.sglang.io/developer_guide/contribution_guide.html#code-style-guidance).

## Review and Merge Process

1. Ping Merge Oncalls to start the process. See the [PR Merge Process](https://github.com/sgl-project/sglang/blob/main/.github/MAINTAINER.md#pull-request-merge-process).
2. Get approvals from [CODEOWNERS](https://github.com/sgl-project/sglang/blob/main/.github/CODEOWNERS) and other reviewers.
3. Trigger CI tests with [comments](https://docs.sglang.io/developer_guide/contribution_guide.html#how-to-trigger-ci-tests) or contact authorized users to do so.
   - Common commands include `/tag-and-rerun-ci`, `/tag-run-ci-label`, `/rerun-failed-ci`
4. After green CI and required approvals, ask Merge Oncalls or people with Write permission to merge the PR.
